item.title: Brooklyn Bridge Park — Procurement: Brooklyn Bridge Park Pier 1 LED Lighting Install
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
Brooklyn Bridge Park is an eighty-five (85) acre waterfront park in Brooklyn, NY. The Pier 1 section of the park is in need of lighting improvements to replace the aging metal halide lights installed during the build-out of the park. All proposed LED light fixtures will need to be tied into a recently installed new lighting panel. Brooklyn Bridge Park is Seeking proposals for an electrical contractor to remove the existing metal halide lighting fixtures and install the LED lighting fixtures and associated wiring.
